name: Remifentanil
summary: Remifentanil, marketed under the brand name Ultiva is a potent, short-acting synthetic opioid analgesic drug. It is given to patients during surgery to relieve pain and as an adjunct to an anesthetic. Remifentanil is used for sedation as well as combined with other medications for use in general anesthesia.

pharmacology.text: Comparing its analgesia-sedation effect in ventilated patients, remifentanil may be superior to morphine but not to fentanyl.

body.says: cleaved by non-specific plasma and tissue esterases

uses.text: Remifentanil is used as an opioid analgesic that has a rapid onset and rapid recovery time. It has been used effectively during craniotomies, spinal surgery, cardiac surgery, and gastric bypass surgery. While opioids function similarly, with respect to analgesia, the pharmacokinetics of remifentanil allows for quicker post-operative recovery.

summaryZh: 瑞吩坦尼（英語：remifentanil）是一種強效、短效的合成阿片類鎮痛藥。它在手術期間給予患者以減輕疼痛並作為麻醉劑的輔助手段。瑞吩坦尼用於鎮靜以及與其他藥物聯合用於全身麻醉。由於瑞吩坦尼與多種安眠藥和揮發性麻醉藥之間的協同作用，瑞吩坦尼的使用使得大劑量阿片類藥物和小劑量催眠麻醉的使用成為可能。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include slowed breathing, low blood pressure, slow heart rate, nausea, vomiting and muscle stiffness. Breathing can stop, so it is only given where breathing can be supported. Even short use can leave people unusually sensitive to pain afterwards.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括呼吸減慢、血壓偏低、心跳變慢、噁心、嘔吐和肌肉僵硬。它可能使呼吸停止，因此只在能支持呼吸的場所使用。即使短時間使用，之後也可能讓人對疼痛異常敏感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括呼吸减慢、血压偏低、心跳变慢、恶心、呕吐和肌肉僵硬。它可能使呼吸停止，因此只在能支持呼吸的场所使用。即使短时间使用，之后也可能让人对疼痛异常敏感。

fact.en: Remifentanil carries an ester group that blood and tissue enzymes clip off almost at once, so it is cleared by the body rather than the liver. That design is why its effect ends so quickly after an infusion is stopped.
fact.zh: 瑞芬太尼帶有一個酯基，血液和組織中的酵素幾乎立刻就會把它切斷，因此它是由全身組織而非肝臟代謝。這個設計也是停止輸注後藥效消退得特別快的原因。
fact.zhHans: 瑞芬太尼带有一个酯基，血液和组织中的酵素几乎立刻就会把它切断，因此它是由全身组织而非肝脏代谢。这个设计也是停止输注后药效消退得特别快的原因。
